title: His stepfather and his mother's baking
summary: He says his half-brothers had a different father, that the stepfather was a contractor, and that his mother was a fine baker.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
